 "content": "from collections import Counter


def _dominant_lines(grid, axis):
    if axis == 0:
        lines = grid
    else:
        lines = [list(col) for col in zip(*grid)]
    return [Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0] for line in lines]


def _longest_periodic(indices):
    """Longest arithmetic progression of indices, excluding adjacent-line runs."""
    indices = sorted(indices)
    best = []
    for i, start in enumerate(indices):
        for end in indices[i + 1:]:
            step = end - start
            if step < 2:
                continue
            seq = [start]
            nxt = start + step
            present = set(indices)
            while nxt in present:
                seq.append(nxt)
                nxt += step
            if len(seq) > len(best):
                best = seq
    return best


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = _dominant_lines(grid, 0)
    col_modes = _dominant_lines(grid, 1)
    colors = set(row_modes) & set(col_modes)

    # Grid-rule color is the regularly spaced row/column color whose crossings
    # carry the strongest non-grid-color signal.
    candidates = []
    for color in colors:
        rows = _longest_periodic([i for i, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == color])
        cols = _longest_periodic([j for j, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value == color])
        if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
            continue
        crossings = [grid[r][c] for r in rows for c in cols]
        anomalous = sum(value != color for value in crossings)
        ratio = anomalous / len(crossings)
        candidates.append((ratio, anomalous, len(rows) * len(cols), color, rows, cols))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, _, _, line_color, rows, cols = max(candidates, key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2]))

    # Ignore unmarked framing intersections; remaining crossings encode the
    # corners of the output cells.
    active_cols = [c for c in cols if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in rows)]
    if len(active_cols) < 2:
        active_cols = cols
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(active_cols) - 1):
            vals = [grid[rows[ri]][active_cols[ci]],
                    grid[rows[ri]][active_cols[ci + 1]],
                    grid[rows[ri + 1]][active_cols[ci]],
                    grid[rows[ri + 1]][active_cols[ci + 1]]]
            if vals[0] != line_color and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
                out_row.append(vals[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
